title: Automate Screenshots with Playwright

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing Playwright's Chromium browser.

steps.title: Step 2: Launch Browser
code_lines: const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
steps.explanation: We launch the browser in headless mode so it runs in the background.

steps.title: Step 3: Navigate to Page
steps.explanation: We create a new page and navigate to the example website.

steps.title: Step 4: Take Screenshot
steps.explanation: Now we take a screenshot and save it as 'example.png'.

steps.title: Step 5: Clean Up
steps.explanation: Finally, we close the browser to free up resources.

steps.title: Step 6: Try It Yourself!
steps.explanation: Try running this code and take your own screenshots!

intro_hook: Ever wanted to take screenshots automatically? Let's see how!
